QuestInfo.name: Signs of Suspicion
QuestInfo.0: Athena Pierce has a favor to ask.
QuestInfo.1: Ever since the Black Mage sent that shadow to Maple Island, he's been suspiciously quiet. Go check to see if the Nautilus is safe.
QuestInfo.2: The Pirate Job Instructor, Kyrin, said Tess was acting suspicious around her. Could Tess really be with the Black Wings?
